name: admin-auth-revoke-refresh-tokens
description: firebase-admin/auth revokeRefreshTokens(uid) advances UserRecord.tokensValidAfterTime so prior ID tokens still pass verifyIdToken(token) and verifyIdToken(token, false) while rejecting verifyIdToken(token, true) with auth/id-token-revoked, forced client getIdToken(true) rejects with auth/user-token-expired, newly minted sessions pass verifyIdToken(token, true), and unknown UIDs reject with auth/user-not-found.
